drhp.business: HD Fire Protect designs and manufactures fire suppression equipment with proprietary in-house designs across 8 product categories serving water-based, foam-based and gas-based suppression applications. Products serve both high-hazard industrial sectors (oil & gas, power, aerospace, data centres, pharmaceuticals) and commercial/residential sectors (hospitality, retail, healthcare). Two manufacturing facilities operate at Jalgaon MIDC (est. 1998, 16,800+ EPU capacity for deluge valves, 379 headcount) and Thane MIDC (est. 2015, 153 headcount). Domestic distribution uses a stockist model; international distribution uses a distributor-led supply chain. Revenue in FY2026 was ₹4,892.81 million with Operating EBITDA margin of 30.75% and PAT margin of 23.12%. The company is debt-free. Order book as of Q1 FY2027 was ₹1,586.01 million.
drhp.one_liner: HD Fire Protect manufactures and exports fire protection equipment — sprinklers, deluge valves, foam equipment and gas suppression systems — serving 49 countries from two Maharashtra facilities.

risks: We offer a standard warranty on our products, typically for a period of 24 months from date of sale or 18 months from date of installation whichever is earlier, though in certain cases this has been extended in line with customer requirements.
These may include the cost of product recalls, penalties for project delays, customer dissatisfaction, or third-party claims.

This includes systematic supplier evaluations through site visits, audits, trial orders, and inspection of incoming raw materials and contract manufactured goods to ensure they meet our internal standards.
These internal quality assurance measures are designed to ensure the highest product quality, minimise the risk of product failure, and reduce the likelihood of any customer loss or dissatisfaction.
We also provide ongoing technical assistance and after-sales support to our customers to reinforce product performance in the field and maintain long-term relationships.
Although there have been a few instances of product replacement due to failures attributed to manufacturing defects, there have been no instances of product recall to date.
While the number of defective units has been minimal and did not warrant a recall, replacements were undertaken to ensure quality assurance and maintain customer satisfaction.
Our products are sold to customers in India and overseas to over 90 countries, with Middle East and Rest of Asia being few of the key markets.

other_material_facts.value: Under the new 2022–23 series, India’s real GDP increased from Rs 261.2 trillion in FY23 to Rs 323.1 trillion in FY26, recording a CAGR of 7.4% during FY23–FY26.

other_material_facts.value: Crisil's projection for India for FY 2027 Macroeconomic variables Forecast for FY27 Real GDP growth 6.6% CPI inflation 5.1% Current account balance (% of GDP) -2.2% Source: Crisil Intelligence Private consumption continues to anchor India’s economic growth India’s Private Final Consumption Expenditure (PFCE) recorded a CAGR of 6.4% during FY23–FY26, with growth accelerating to 7.7% in FY26.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The industry sector, which comprises manufacturing; electricity, gas, water supply and other utility services; and construction activities, stood at Rs 81.0 trillion in FY26(PE), compared with Rs 61.8 trillion in FY23, thereby registering a CAGR of 9.4% between FY23 and FY26(PE).

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The services sector, meanwhile, accounted for ~53% of total GVA in FY26(PE) and recorded a CAGR of 8.1% over the same period.

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence
other_material_facts.value: The primary sector grew at a CAGR of 3.6% between FY23 and FY26(PE), with its share moderating from 20% in FY23 to ~18% in FY26(PE).

other_material_facts.label: industry_evidence

overview.business_model: HD Fire Protect designs and manufactures fire suppression equipment with proprietary in-house designs across 8 product categories serving water-based, foam-based and gas-based suppression applications. Products serve both high-hazard industrial sectors (oil & gas, power, aerospace, data centres, pharmaceuticals) and commercial/residential sectors (hospitality, retail, healthcare). Two manufacturing facilities operate at Jalgaon MIDC (est. 1998, 16,800+ EPU capacity for deluge valves, 379 headcount) and Thane MIDC (est. 2015, 153 headcount). Domestic distribution uses a stockist model; international distribution uses a distributor-led supply chain. Revenue in FY2026 was ₹4,892.81 million with Operating EBITDA margin of 30.75% and PAT margin of 23.12%. The company is debt-free. Order book as of Q1 FY2027 was ₹1,586.01 million.
overview.business_overview:
We are an Indian manufacturer and supplier of fire protection equipment and systems, offering a comprehensive portfolio spanning water, foam, and gas-based fire suppression systems, which are also generally known as fire fighting products. We develop majority of our products in-house with proprietary designs to meet national and international standards, serving high-hazard industrial applications as well as residential and commercial sectors. According to the CRISIL Report on page 203, we were the second-largest manufacturer of fire protection equipment and systems in India in terms of operating income (revenue from operations) in Fiscal 2025 and the largest exporter by value (equipment) in Fiscal 2025. We have export sales in 49 countries as of the three months period ended June 30, 2026 and more than 90 countries as of Fiscal 2026. With more than three decades of experience, we have established ourselves as a globally recognized and reliable brand.

In the early 1990s, critical fire protection equipment and systems such as deluge valves, alarm valves, and medium velocity water spray nozzles were generally imported, with lack of Indian manufacturers offering high-quality alternatives like UL Listed and FM Approved products (Source: CRISIL Report page 170). Our Company is the first Indian fire protection equipment and systems manufacturer to receive UL Listing for deluge valves (1996) (Source: CRISIL Report page 202). Since the commencement of our business, we have consistently focused on providing locally manufactured fire protection equipment and systems as import-substitutes. We are also the first Indian fire protection equipment and systems manufacturer to receive FM approval for range of products used in low expansion foam system namely foam concentrates, bladder tanks, proportioners, topside discharge devices and foam water sprinkler discharge devices (Source: CRISIL Report page 202). Further, we are also the first Indian company focused on fire protection equipment and systems manufacturing to receive ASME U (pressure vessels) stamp certification (Source: CRISIL Report page 202). With 21 and 87 UL Listed and FM Approved certifications, as per UL product certifications and FM product certifications respectively, we have the highest number of UL Listed and FM Approved product certifications amongst the fire protection equipment focused peers in India as of September 2026 (Source: CRISIL Report page 202).

Our business was originally carried on under the name M/s HD Fire Protect Co., which was established by Harish Dharamshi as a partnership firm on April 27, 1990. Our Company was incorporated on April 24, 1997, as ‘D.H. Fire Protect Private Limited’ and in the year 2005 the name of our Company was changed to ‘HD Fire Protect Private Limited’. Thereafter, on April 1, 2005, our Company acquired M/s HD Fire Protect Co., as a going concern along with all its assets and liabilities, and the business was consolidated under a single corporate entity.

As of June 30, 2026, our offerings are spread across 8 product categories, namely - (a) sprinklers, alarm valves and accessories, (b) deluge valves, deluge skids and pre-action systems, (c) foam equipment and suppression systems, (d) monitors and monitor nozzles, (e) systems valves and accessories, (f) water spray nozzles, (g) custom engineered systems, and (h) gas suppression systems, covering a wide spectrum of (a) industrial end use in sectors such as industrials, heavy engineering, aerospace, oil & gas, refining and petrochemicals, power & energy, pharmaceuticals, data centres, warehousing amongst others; and (b) residential and commercial end use in sectors such as hospitality, healthcare, retail, education, banking and warehousing. We are also empanelled with various customers across sectors where we have presence.

We operate two manufacturing facilities in Maharashtra, Jalgaon MIDC and Thane MIDC, spanning a combined area of 8.50 acres. We have expanded the capacity of our Jalgaon facility, with one unit for manufacturing and another for a dedicated fire test laboratory, industrial warehouse and R&D centre, admeasuring 2.50 acres, and are also constructing a warehouse at Wagle Estate, Thane, admeasuring 0.50 acres, which is expected to be completed by November 2026. In addition to our in-house production, we also undertake contract manufacturing of off-the-shelf products as well as white labelling to cater to diverse customer requirements. In Fiscal 2026, we supplied our fire protection equipment and systems to 2,066 customers. We supplied our fire protection equipment and systems across 49 countries in the three-month period ended June 30, 2026, and across more than 90 countries between inception and March 31, 2026. This international reach is supported by a distributor-led supply chain for international markets and a stockist model for India.

We maintain a strong focus on quality, reflected in the absence of product recalls and a replacement rate of just 0.01% over the three months period ended June 30, 2026 and the past three fiscals. Our R&D initiatives are directed toward next-generation technologies that enhance performance, ensure environmental compliance, and meet global certification standards. We also specialize in custom-engineered fire protection skids tailored to client-specific requirements and are the only Indian manufacturer to offer certain advanced systems, such as a next-generation pre-action system. Our innovation pipeline includes a new deluge valve design, for which a patent application is currently under process. As on the date of this Red Herring Prospectus, we hold patents in the United States of America, India, Turkey and Saudi Arabia for "pressure operated fluid valve with configurable diaphragm arrangement", and two design registrations in India for "diaphragm of fire protection valve". We have also made a patent application in the United Arab Emirates in respect of the same.

We have supplied products at some of the key sites including master stream nozzle installations at India's space launch pad at Sriharikota, fire protection equipment (alarm valve, monitor, master stream nozzle) at India's largest refinery at Jamnagar, fire protection equipment (drain valve, water flow detectors etc.) for the new Indian parliament building, fire protection systems (deluge valves) at Saudi Aramco's Ras Tanura Sea Island site and fire protection equipment (deluge valves, sprinklers etc.) for Oman's Integrated Power & Water Plant Project (Source: CRISIL Report page 199). These projects highlight both the global acceptability and trust placed in our equipment and systems.

Our key export destinations include UAE, Saudi Arabia, Brazil, Turkey, Malaysia, and Indonesia. The map below details the destinations we export to as on the date of this RHP:

We are guided by a group of seasoned promoters and accomplished industry professionals whose collective experience forms the foundation of our sustained growth and operational excellence. Harish Narshi Dharamshi, one of our Promoters as well as the Chairman and Managing Director provides strategic leadership and brings over 41 years of experience in the fire protection industry. Similarly, our other Promoters, namely, Miheer Sadanand Ghotikar, Anik Narendra Dharamshi, and Parika Miheer Ghotikar, oversee various business functions and each of them bring over 16 years of experience, respectively, in the fire protection industry.

We have demonstrated strong and consistent financial performance across last 3 fiscals and the three months period ended June 30, 2026. Our Revenue from Operations stood at ₹1,090.52 million, ₹4,892.81 million, ₹4,327.99 million, and ₹3,729.53 million for the three months period ended June 30, 2026, Fiscal 2026, Fiscal 2025, and Fiscal 2024, respectively, reflecting a CAGR of 14.54% from Fiscal 2024 to Fiscal 2026. Our Operating EBITDA for the respective periods stood at ₹297.25 million, ₹1,504.59 million, ₹1,380.08 million, and ₹1,066.32 million, translating to Operating EBITDA margins of 27.26%, 30.75%, 31.89%, and 28.59%. Similarly, our PAT was ₹238.65 million in the three months period ended June 30, 2026, ₹1,167.87 million in Fiscal 2026, ₹1,097.18 million in Fiscal 2025, and ₹879.20 million in Fiscal 2024, translating to PAT margins of 20.92%, 23.12%, 24.35%, and 22.43%, respectively. As of the end of the three months period ended June 30, 2026 and Fiscals 2026, 2025, and 2024, our order book stood at ₹1,586.01 million, ₹ 1,344.48 million, ₹703.45 million, and ₹752.92 million, respectively, providing strong visibility for future growth.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- We offer a standard warranty on our products, typically for a period of 24 months from date of sale or 18 months from date of installation whichever is earlier, though in certain cases this has been extended in line with customer requirements.
- These may include the cost of product recalls, penalties for project delays, customer dissatisfaction, or third-party claims.
- This includes systematic supplier evaluations through site visits, audits, trial orders, and inspection of incoming raw materials and contract manufactured goods to ensure they meet our internal standards.
- These internal quality assurance measures are designed to ensure the highest product quality, minimise the risk of product failure, and reduce the likelihood of any customer loss or dissatisfaction.
- We also provide ongoing technical assistance and after-sales support to our customers to reinforce product performance in the field and maintain long-term relationships.
- Although there have been a few instances of product replacement due to failures attributed to manufacturing defects, there have been no instances of product recall to date.
- While the number of defective units has been minimal and did not warrant a recall, replacements were undertaken to ensure quality assurance and maintain customer satisfaction.
- Our products are sold to customers in India and overseas to over 90 countries, with Middle East and Rest of Asia being few of the key markets.

- Strategic capacity expansion at our Jalgaon and Thane facilities and infrastructure enhancement to increase our efficiency and shorten lead time
- Expanding geographic presence internationally through strategic global partnerships
